"Group 2" Correctable VI (CVI): visual acuity, presenting is worse than 20/40, but visual acuity with refraction is 20/40 or better. "Group 3" Nonrefractive VI (NVI): visual acuity, presenting  is worse than 20/40, and visual  acuity with refraction  is still worse than 20/40. - diabetes = 1 if (Ever told you had diabetes = "Yes" OR Glycohemoglobin (%) >= 6.5); 0 otherwise

CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step1 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_inclusion_step1 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."age_in_years_at_screening" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.2: Exclude patients with missing ever told you had diabetes
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step2 AS

-- ========== STEP 3: Cohort ==========

-- The final temp table in the exclusion sequence becomes temp_cohort.
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_cohort AS
SELECT "respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step7;

-- ========== STEP 4: Variables ==========

-- 4.1 Vision Group
-- Extract denominator from visual acuity strings for presenting vision
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_va_presenting_denominators AS
SELECT
  c."respondent_sequence_number",
  CAST(SUBSTRING(REPLACE(REPLACE(f."right_visual_acuity_presenting", '+', ''), '-', '') FROM POSITION('/' IN f."right_visual_acuity_presenting") + 1) AS NUMERIC) AS "right_va_presenting_denom",
  CAST(SUBSTRING(REPLACE(REPLACE(f."left_visual_acuity_presenting", '+', ''), '-', '') FROM POSITION('/' IN f."left_visual_acuity_presenting") + 1) AS NUMERIC) AS "left_va_presenting_denom"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- Extract denominator from visual acuity strings for refraction vision
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_va_refraction_denominators AS
SELECT
  c."respondent_sequence_number",
  CAST(SUBSTRING(REPLACE(REPLACE(f."right_visual_acuity_w_obj_refraction", '+', ''), '-', '') FROM POSITION('/' IN f."right_visual_acuity_w_obj_refraction") + 1) AS NUMERIC) AS "right_va_refraction_denom",
  CAST(SUBSTRING(REPLACE(REPLACE(f."left_visual_acuity_w_obj_refraction", '+', ''), '-', '') FROM POSITION('/' IN f."left_visual_acuity_w_obj_refraction") + 1) AS NUMERIC) AS "left_va_refraction_denom"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- Calculate better_va_presenting and better_va_refraction (minimum denominator means better vision)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_better_va AS
SELECT
  p."respondent_sequence_number",
  LEAST(p."right_va_presenting_denom", p."left_va_presenting_denom") AS "better_va_presenting",
  LEAST(r."right_va_refraction_denom", r."left_va_refraction_denom") AS "better_va_refraction"
FROM temp_va_presenting_denominators p
JOIN temp_va_refraction_denominators r ON p."respondent_sequence_number" = r."respondent_sequence_number";

-- Categorize into vision groups
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_vision_group AS
SELECT
  "respondent_sequence_number",
  CASE
    WHEN "better_va_presenting" IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN "better_va_refraction" IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN "better_va_presenting" <= 40 THEN 'Group 1 No VI'
    WHEN "better_va_presenting" > 40 AND "better_va_refraction" <= 40 THEN 'Group 2 Correctable VI (CVI)'
    WHEN "better_va_presenting" > 40 AND "better_va_refraction" > 40 THEN 'Group 3 Nonrefractive VI (NVI)'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS "vision_group"
FROM temp_better_va;

-- 4.2 Diabetes
-- Determine raw diabetes status based on diagnosis or glycohemoglobin level
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_diabetes_raw AS
SELECT
  c."respondent_sequence_number",
  (f."doctor_told_you_have_diabetes" = 'Yes' OR f."glycohemoglobin" >= 6.5) AS "has_diabetes_boolean"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- Map diabetes status to 1 or 0
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_diabetes AS
SELECT
  "respondent_sequence_number",
  CASE
    WHEN "has_diabetes_boolean" THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS "diabetes"
FROM temp_diabetes_raw;

-- ========== STEP 5: Final Table ==========
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_final_table AS
SELECT
  c."respondent_sequence_number",
  vg."vision_group",
  d."diabetes"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN temp_vision_group vg ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = vg."respondent_sequence_number"
JOIN temp_diabetes d ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = d."respondent_sequence_number";

-- ========== STEP 6: Final Output ==========
SELECT * FROM temp_final_table;

-- STEP: Create merged final table with design variables + in_analysis flag
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_final_with_weights;

CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_final_with_weights AS
SELECT 
    wd."respondent_sequence_number",
    wd."masked_variance_pseudo_psu",
    wd."masked_variance_pseudo_stratum",
    wd."survey_weight",
    CASE WHEN ft."respondent_sequence_number" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "in_analysis",
    ft."vision_group",
    ft."diabetes"
FROM weight_design wd
LEFT JOIN temp_final_table ft
  ON wd."respondent_sequence_number" = ft."respondent_sequence_number";
